checks.text: Gate. CHEOPS DRP M dwarfs: flux-inverted null (real flares masked) at most 10% of the real flare count, with and without denoising
Gate. CHEOPS DRP M dwarfs: injected flares with S/N >= 10 and FWHM >= 3 cadences recovered, 95% interval lower bound >= 0.8
CHEOPS DRP M dwarfs (denoised): complex fraction's 95% interval contains Poyatos et al.'s ~0.40 (only if both gates pass)
checks.why: a gate (the CHEOPS null or injection check) did not pass; the comparison is not interpretable

checks.text: CHEOPS DRP M dwarfs (denoised): power-law index within 2 sigma (combined) of Poyatos et al.'s 1.92 +/- 0.07 (only if both gates pass)
checks.why: a gate (the CHEOPS null or injection check) did not pass; the comparison is not interpretable

checks.text: Same input as pycheops: on every reference visit our decorrelation matches pycheops' to < 10 ppm rms, or reaches a lower rms on the same points and terms (relaxed after v1)
End to end (DACE DRP arrays vs pycheops' DRP product): correlation >= 0.9 on every reference visit
HR 10 CHEOPS, three public visits together: the two strongest TESS delta Scuti frequencies (f1, f2) found

cheops_flares.data: CHEOPS DRP (subarray) light curves via DACE public mode; Poyatos et al. used 3-s imagettes reduced with PIPE, which DACE does not serve
